config.rules: prey: move (pay move_cost) -> eat grown grass (+prey_gain, reset regrow) -> die if energy<0 -> reproduce w.p. prey_reproduce (split energy). predator: move -> eat one prey on cell (+pred_gain, prey dies) -> die if energy<0 -> reproduce w.p. pred_reproduce (split energy). grass: regrows grass_regrow ticks after grazing (carrying-capacity term).
config.locked_metric: prey & predator population time series; survival fraction; cross-correlation(prey, predator) peak lag

verdicts.label: P1
verdicts.gate: P1 sustained oscillations, no extinction: both species >=2 peaks AND neither extinct in >=60% of seeds

verdicts.label: P2
verdicts.gate: P2 predator lags prey: cross-correlation(prey, predator) peaks at a POSITIVE lag (majority of surviving seeds; positive median lag)

verdicts.label: P3
verdicts.gate: P3 persistence: oscillation continues into the last third (both species peak there) in >=60% of surviving seeds
